title: servers/<slug>/.codex-plugin/plugin.json
description: mcpServers points at the plugin's MCP config for server entries. A skill-only plugin omits it and sets `skills` instead — Codex requires at least one component, not specifically an MCP server (verified against developers.openai.com/codex/plugins/build, 2026-08-18). No-auth/oauth entries share ./.mcp.json with Claude; credentialed entries use ./.codex-plugin/mcp.json because Codex reads http_headers, not Claude's headers key.

skills.description: Relative path to the bundled skills directory, e.g. "./skills/".
